7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Ten years without answers: the continuing search for Rochdale’s Jack Stewart Rochdale
    Jack Stewart vanished from Spotland on 8 February 2016. His missing-person appeal remains listed a decade later. Here are the original clothing details, what the community did,…
  • 651 SEWAGE SPILLS INTO THE RIVER ROCH: 3,271 HOURS OF DISCHARGES — WHAT IS IN OUR WATER AND WHO PAYS? Rochdale
    Seventeen outlets discharged into the River Roch in 2025. Rochdale Daily examines what residents and wildlife may be exposed to, how water is tested, why storm overflows…
  • FIVE YEARS LATER, A COURT SUMMONS: Rochdale residents report historic Council Tax demands as arrears reach £28.4m Rochdale
    Several residents tell Rochdale Daily they have received summonses for old Council Tax bills, including a 2021 account. With arrears reportedly £28.4m, we examine recovery…
  • BREAKING INVESTIGATION: £50.3m owed by Rochdale Council companies as £19.5m Council Tax shortfall raises scrutiny Rochdale
    Rochdale's draft accounts show £50.309m in Upperbanks company loan balances, £2.02m interest added and only £132,000 repaid in 2025/26. We examine the figures, the 2022…
  • Did Robin Hood really come to Healey Dell? Healey
    Local stories tie a lost ring, witches and a 'Fairy Chapel' to Robin Hood — the tales are colourful, but what do the records actually show?
  • Halloween in Rochdale 2026: parties, pumpkins and spooky events across the borough Rochdale
    39 dated Halloween listings across Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Milnrow, Littleborough, Norden and Wardle, with prices, times, age suitability, venues and booking links.
  • East Middleton councillor questions parking charge warning after petrol station breakdown Middleton
    Labour councillor Georgina Jacques says she was warned about a parking charge while waiting for the RAC after her car broke down on Oldham Road.

Weather: Light rain 16°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
